Onyame biara nni ho gyese Allah nkoaa, a onni hokafo; Ne deɛ ne tumidi na Ne dea ne ayeyi, na Ɔwɔ tumi wɔ adeɛ nyinaa so. M’Awurade, mesrɛ Wo anadwo yi mu papa ne nea ɛdi akyire yie, na mehwehwɛ guankɔbea wɔ Wo mu firi anadwo yi bone ne bɔne a ɛdi akyire no ho. §a.mulk.v: Na Anabi صلى الله عليه وسلم ka no anɔpa ne anwummere biara.
§a.mulk.s: Sahih Muslim (2723) Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so.
§a.bika.m: O Allah, Wo so na yefa mu adekyee na Wo na yedi mu anwummere, Wo so na yetena ase na Wo na yewu, na Wo na owusɔreɛ wɔ hɔ.
§a.bika.e: O Allah, ɛnam Wo so na yɛhyɛn anwummerɛ no mu na ɛnam Wo so na yɛhyɛn anɔpa, ɛnam Wo so na yɛtena ase na ɛnam Wo so na yɛwu, na Wo nkyɛn na sanba a ɛtwa toɔ no wɔ.
§a.bika.v: Anabi صلى الله عليه وسلم kyerɛkyerɛɛ no ​​kyerɛɛ n’Ahokafoɔ.
§a.bika.s: Al-Tirmidhi (3391) ne Abu Dawud (5068); hwɛ Sahih al-Tirmidhi (3/142) Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so.
§a.sayyid.m: O Allah, Wo ne m'Awurade; onyame biara nni ho gye Wo. Wobɔɔ me na meyɛ W’akoa, na midi W’apam ne wo bɔhyɛ so sɛnea metumi. Mehwehwɛ guankɔbea wɔ Wo mu fi dee mayɛ bɔne no ho. Megye W’adom to me so na megye me bɔne tom, enti fa kyɛ me, ɛfiri sɛ obiara mfa bɔne nkyɛ me gye Wo.
§a.sayyid.v: Fafiri ho adesrɛ a ɛyɛ nwonwa: obiara a ɔde awerɛhyem bɛka no anwummere na wawu saa anadwo no, ɔhyɛn Paradise, na saa ara nso na anɔpa.
§a.sayyid.s: Sahih al-Bukhari (6306) Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so.
§a.ushhid.m: O Allah, mahyɛne anɔpa refrɛ Wo sɛ di adanseɛ, na mafrɛ W’ahengua soafoɔ, W’abɔfoɔ ne W’abɔdeɛ nyinaa sɛ wɔnni adanseɛ, sɛ Wone Allah, onyame biara nni hɔ gyese Wo nko ara a onni ɔhokafoɔ, na Muhammad yɛ W’akoa ne W’asomafoɔ.
§a.ushhid.e: O Allah, mahyɛne anwummerɛ no mu afrɛ Wo sɛ di adanseɛ, na mafrɛ W’Ahengua soafoɔ, W’abɔfoɔ ne W’abɔdeɛ nyinaa sɛ wɔnni adanseɛ, sɛ Wone Allah, onyame biara nni hɔ gyese Wo nko ara a onni ɔhokafoɔ, na Muhammad yɛ W’akoa ne W’asomafoɔ.
§a.ushhid.v: Obiara a obeka no mprenu no, Allah de ne ho firi Egya no mu.
§a.ushhid.s: Abu Dawud (5069) ne ne mfɛfoɔ; Ibn Baz de ne nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no too gua yiye wɔ Tuhfat al-Akhyar mu
§a.ushhid.n: Al-Albani buu no sɛ ɛyɛ mmerɛw.
§a.nima.m: O Allah, nhyira biara a me anaa W'abɔdeɛ biara wɔ anɔpa yi firi Wo nko ara, a ɔnni ɔhokafoɔ. Wo na ayeyie ye na Wo na aseda nso ye.
§a.nima.e: O Allah, nhyira biara a me anaa W'abɔdeɛ biara wɔ saa anwummerɛ yi firi Wo nko ara, a onni ɔhokafoɔ. Wo na ayeyie ye na Wo na aseda nso ye.
§a.nima.v: Obiara a ɔbɛka no anɔpa no, wada ase wɔ ne da no ho, na obiara a ɔbɛka no anwummere no, wada ne anadwo ase.
§a.nima.s: Abu Dawud (5073) ne ne mfɛfoɔ; Ibn Baz de ne nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no too gua yiye wɔ Tuhfat al-Akhyar mu
§a.nima.n: Al-Albani buu no sɛ ɛyɛ mmerɛw.
§a.afini.m: O Allah, ma me yiedie wo me nipadua mu. O Allah, ma me yiedie wo m'aso mu. O Allah, ma me yiedie wo m'anim. Onyame biara nni hɔ gye Wo. O Allah, mehwehwe dwanekobea wo Wo ho firi atoro ne ohia mu, na mehwehwe dwanekobea wo Wo mu firi adamena mu asotwe ho. Onyame biara nni hɔ gye Wo.
§a.afini.v: Na Anabi صلى الله عليه وسلم de no srɛsrɛ mprɛnsa anɔpa ne anwummerɛ biara.
§a.afini.s: Abu Dawud (5090) ne Ahmad (5/42); Ibn Baz de ne nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no too gua yiye wɔ Tuhfat al-Akhyar mu
§a.hasbi.m: Allah dɔɔso ma me; onyame biara nni hɔ gye Ɔno. Ne mu na mede me ho to no so, na Ɔno ne Ahennwa a Ɔyɛ Tumfoɔ no Awurade.
§a.hasbi.v: Obiara a obeka no mprenu nson adekyee ne anwummere no, Allah behye no wo biribiara a efa ewiase yi ne Daankwamma ho.
§a.hasbi.s: Abu Dawud (5081) sɛ Abu al-Darda asɛm; Shuayb ne Abd al-Qadir al-Arnaut de ne nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no too gua sɛ ɛyɛ nokware wɔ wɔn Zad al-Maad (2/376) .
§a.hasbi.n: Nokwarem no, ɛyɛ Ɔhokafoɔ asɛm, na ne nsɛm wɔ Kur’aan mu (al-Tawbah 9:129).
§a.afw.m: O Allah, mesre Wo bonefakye ne yiedie wo ewiase ne Daankwamma. O Allah, mesrɛ Wo bɔne fafiri ne yiedie wɔ me som mu, me wiase nsɛm, m’abusua ne m’ahonyadeɛ mu. O Allah, kata me mfomsoɔ so na ma me suro dwo. O Allah, hw me firi m’anim ne m’akyi, firi me nifa ne me benkum, ne me soro, na mehwehwe guantenbea wo Wo kesee mu se wobegye me afiri m’ase a wonnim.
§a.afw.v: Anabi صلى الله عليه وسلم annyae saa nkotɔsrɛ yi anwummere ne anɔpa da.
§a.afw.s: Abu Dawud (5074) ne Ibn Majah (3871); al-Albani de too gua sɛ ɛyɛ nokware wɔ Sahih Ibn Majah (2/332) mu .
§a.alim.m: O Allah, Dwuma a wonhunu ne nea wohunu, Esoro ne asaase Bɔfoa, Awurade ne adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ, medi adanseɛ sɛ onyame biara nni hɔ gye Wo. Mehwehwɛ guankɔbea wɔ Wo mu firi me kra bɔne ne Satan bɔne ne ne frɛ sɛ me ne Wo mmɔ ahokafoɔ, ne sɛ mede bɔne bɛba me ho anaa Muslimi biara so.
§a.alim.v: Anabi صلى الله عليه وسلم kyerɛkyerɛɛ no ​​maa Abu Bakr sɛ ɔnka anɔpa, anwummere ne nna mu.
§a.alim.s: Al-Tirmidhi (3392) ne Abu Dawud (5067); hwɛ Sahih al-Tirmidhi (3/142) Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so.
§a.bismillah.m: Allah din mu, a ne din ntumi mfa biribiara mmra asaase so anaase esoro mu, na 3no ne 3tiefoa, 3nimdee nyinaa.
§a.bismillah.v: Obiara a obeka no mprɛnsa anɔpa ne mprɛnsa anwummere no, biribiara rempira no.
§a.bismillah.s: Abu Dawud (5088), al-Tirmidhi (3388) ne Ibn Majah (3869); Ibn Baz de ne nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no too gua yiye wɔ Tuhfat al-Akhyar mu
§a.bismillah.n: Al-Albani buu no sɛ ɛyɛ nokware.
§a.radit.m: M’ani gye Allah ho sɛ m’Awurade, ne Islam sɛ me som, ne Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم sɛ m’Akɔmhyɛni.
§a.radit.v: Obiara a obeka no mprɛnsa anɔpa ne anwummere no, Allah ahyɛ bɔ sɛ ɔbɛsɔ n’ani wɔ Owusɔre Da no mu.
§a.radit.s: Abu Dawud (5072), al-Tirmidhi (3389) ne Ahmad (4/337); Ibn Baz de too gua sɛ eye wɔ Tuhfat al-Akhyar mu
§a.radit.n: Nsɛmfua no ankasa yɛ nokware wɔ Sahih Muslim (386), a wɔkae bere a wɔtee mpaebɔ frɛ no.
§a.hayy.m: O Ɔteasefoɔ Daa, O Ne nyinaa sohwɛfoɔ, ɛnam Wo mmɔborɔhunu so hwehwɛ mmoa. Siesie me nsɛm nyinaa, na nnyaw me mma me ho mpo.
§a.hayy.v: Anabi صلى الله عليه وسلم tuu Fatimah fo sɛ ɔnka no anɔpa ne anwummerɛ biara.
§a.hayy.s: Al-Hakim (1/545), a ɔde too gua sɛ ɛyɛ nokware a al-Dhahabi penee so; al-Albani de too gua sɛ eye wɔ Sahih al-Targhib wa al-Tarhib (1/273) mu.
§a.fath.m: Yɛahyɛne anɔpa, na tumidi nyinaa yɛ Allah dea, ewiase nyinaa wura. O Allah, mesre Wo da yi papa: ne nkonimdie, ne mmoa, ne hann, ne nhyira ne ne kwankyere, na mehwehwe dwaneko wo Wo mu firi bone a ewo mu ne bone a ewo akyire no ho.
§a.fath.e: Yɛahyɛn anwummere no mu, na tumidi nyinaa yɛ Allah dea, ewiase nyinaa wura. O Allah, mesrɛ Wo anadwo yi mu papa: ne nkonimdie, ne mmoa, ne hann, ne nhyira ne ne kwankyerɛ, na mehwehwɛ guankɔbea wɔ Wo mu firi bɔne a ɛwɔ mu ne bɔne a ɛwɔ akyire no ho.
§a.fath.s: Abu Dawud (5084) ne ne mfɛfoɔ; Shuayb ne Abd al-Qadir al-Arnaut de ne nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no too gua yiye wɔ wɔn Zad al-Maad (2/273) nkyerɛase no mu.
§a.fath.n: Al-Albani buu no sɛ ɛyɛ mmerɛw.
§a.fitra.m: Yɛahyɛne anɔpa wɔ Islam abɔdeɛ kwan so, wɔ gyidie a ɛyɛ nokware asɛm so, yɛn Ɔkɔmhyɛni Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم som so, ne yɛn agya Ibrahim kwan so, ɔteneneefoɔ na ɔbrɛ ne ho ase, na na ɔnka wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho bata Allah ho.
§a.fitra.e: Yɛahyɛn anwummerɛ no mu wɔ Islam abɔdeɛ kwan so, wɔ gyidie a ɛyɛ nokware asɛm so, wɔ yɛn Ɔkɔmhyɛni Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم som so, ne yɛn agya Ibrahim kwan so, ɔteneneefoɔ na ɔbrɛ ne ho ase, na na ɔnka wɔn a wɔde ahokafoɔ bata Allah ho no ho.
§a.fitra.s: Ahmad (3/406–407) ne Ibn al-Sunni wɔ Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah (34) mu; hwɛ Sahih al-Jami (4/209) Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so.
§a.subhan.m: Animuonyam nka Allah, na ayeyi nka No.
§a.subhan.v: Obiara a obeka no mpɛn ɔha anɔpa ne anwummere no, obiara remfa biribi a eye kyɛn so mma Owusɔre Da no gyese obiako a ɔkaa saa ara anaa nea ɛboro saa.
§a.subhan.s: Sahih Muslim (2692) Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so.
§a.tahlil10.m: Onyame biara nni ho gyese Allah nkoaa, a onni hokafo. Ne deɛ ne tumidi na Ne dea ne ayeyi, na Ɔwɔ tumi wɔ adeɛ nyinaa so.
§a.tahlil10.v: Mpɛn du, anaa pɛnkoro bere a wabrɛ; obiara a ɔbɛka no mprɛ du no te sɛ obi a ɔde akra nnan fii Ismail asefo nsam.
§a.tahlil10.s: Sahih Muslim (2693) ne ne mfɛfoɔ; hwɛ Sahih al-Targhib wa al-Tarhib (1/272) Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so.
§a.tahlil100.m: Onyame biara nni ho gyese Allah nkoaa, a onni hokafo. Ne deɛ ne tumidi na Ne dea ne ayeyi, na Ɔwɔ tumi wɔ adeɛ nyinaa so.
§a.tahlil100.v: Mpɛn ɔha anɔpa: ɛne nkoa du a wɔbɛde wɔn ho no yɛ pɛ, wɔkyerɛw nnwuma pa ɔha ma no, wɔpopa bɔne ɔha, na ɛbɔ ne ho ban fi Satan ho saa da no kosi anwummere.
§a.adad.m: Animuonyam nka Allah na ayeyie nka No, mpɛn dodoɔ a ɛyɛ N’abɔdeɛ dodoɔ, sɛdeɛ ɛsɔ N’ani, emu yɛ duru te sɛ N’Ahennwa, ne N’asɛm mu ink.
§a.adad.v: Anabi صلى الله عليه وسلم kaa wɔn kyerɛɛ Juwayriyah wɔ adekyee mpaebɔ no akyi, na ɔkaa sɛ wɔbɛboro nea waka firi anɔpa no nyinaa so.
§a.adad.s: Sahih Muslim (2726) Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so.
§a.ilm.m: O Allah, mesre Wo nimdee a mfasoo wo so, nsiesiei pa ne nnwuma a wogye tom.
§a.ilm.v: Na Anabi صلى الله عليه وسلم ka no bere a wawie adekyee mpaebɔ no akyi.
§a.ilm.s: Ibn Majah (925) ne Ibn al-Sunni (54); al-Albani de too gua sɛ ɛyɛ nokware wɔ Sahih Ibn Majah mu
§a.istighfar.m: Mehwehwe Allah bonefakye na medane ma Ne ho wo adwensakyera mu.
§a.istighfar.v: Na Anabi صلى الله عليه وسلم hwehwɛɛ Allah bɔnefakyɛ na ɔsakyera ne ho frɛ no mpɛn ɔha da biara.
§a.kalimat.m: Mehwehwɛ guankɔbea wɔ Allah nsɛm a ɛyɛ pɛ mu firi dee Wabɔ no bɔne ho.
§a.kalimat.v: Obiara a ɔbɛka no anwummere no, nsɔe biara rempira no saa anadwo no.
§a.kalimat.s: Sahih Muslim (2709), Ahmad (2/290) ne al-Nasai wɔ Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah (590) mu.
§a.salat.m: O Allah, fa nhyira ne asomdwoe mmra yen Anabi Muhammad so.
§a.salat.v: Obiara a obesoma nhyira agu me so mpren du anɔpa ne anwummere du no, obenya me ntamgyinafo Owusore Da no.
§a.salat.s: Al-Tabarani, ne ne mfɛfoɔ; hwɛ Majma al-Zawaid (10/120) ne Sahih al-Targhib wa al-Tarhib (1/273) .
§a.salat.n: Wogye ne nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no ho akyinnye; suban pa a ɛne sɛ wɔde nhyira bɛkɔ Ɔkɔmhyɛni صلى الله عليه وسلم so no yɛ nokorɛ wɔ Sahih Muslim (408) mu.
